name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was returned using the OpenAI Python SDK with the Fireworks-compatible endpoint.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the available models endpoint to find an accessible model and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` to make the API call succeed. All other steps (OpenAI SDK installation, base_url, API key from env var, code structure) followed the docs exactly.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-a582fc330ac64ef6861c56f453249011'}

friction.detail: accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1 returned 404: 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'
accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct also returned 404 NOT_FOUND with the same 'Model not found' message
Had to run curl against /v1/models to find a valid model because the documented examples were unavailable
